title: Pure Elfnote
summary: Elfnote cards plus the Medius the Pure package that fetches Elfnote Power Patron, with generic staples. The page's combo lines add the Power Patron Link Monsters, so they use cards this list leaves out. The Elfnotes take turns in the center Main Monster Zone: Lucina searches, Regina pulls another from the Deck, Tinia and Fortuna place the Continuous Spells and Traps, and Elfnote Power Patron Synchro Summons on the spot. Power Patron and Welcome Home lock you into Synchros, so the Extra Deck is Elfnote first.

allow.Medius the Pure: Summoned, it adds or summons Elfnote Power Patron from the Deck.
allow.Theorealized Medius: Newest Medius support: comes in off Elfnote Power Patron and searches a Theorealize card.
allow.Theorealize Past Lull: With an Elfnote card out, summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck.
allow.Theorealize Overdrive: Revives Medius the Pure, and from the GY sets a monster's Level for the Synchro.
allow.Junora the Power Patron of Tuning: The Synchro Elfnote Power Patron and Junoldo summon.

main: Elfnote Lucina
Special Summons itself to the center zone and searches another Elfnote; on the opponent's turn, swaps into the center to bounce a monster.
Elfnote Regina
Newest Main Deck Elfnote. Sends another Elfnote to summon itself on either turn; in the center zone, summons an Elfnote from the Deck.
Elfnote Fortuna
Special Summons itself to the center zone and places an Elfnote Continuous Trap; on the opponent's turn, swaps in to bounce a Spell/Trap.
Elfnote Tinia
Limited. Special Summons itself to the center zone and places an Elfnote Continuous Spell; swaps in to banish a card from the opponent's hand.
Elfnote Power Patron
Quick Effect: raises the center monster's Level by 3 and Synchro Summons an Elfnote or Junora at once; used as material, searches an Elfnote card. Synchro-only Extra Deck while it's out.
Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons Elfnote Power Patron; revives itself from the GY.
Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron
Counts as Elfnote: banishes the top three cards to bring out Junora; in the Pendulum Zone, draws two when an Elfnote arrives.
Theorealized Medius
Newest support. Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card.
Elfnotes: Welcome Home
Protects the center monster from destruction, and sends a monster to summon an Elfnote of a different Attribute from the Deck.
Elfnotes: A Plea for Help
Protects the center monster from targeting, with extra effects by its Attribute.
Theorealize Past Lull
With an Elfnote card out, summons Medius the Pure and the opponent can't respond.
Theorealize Overdrive
Revives Medius the Pure; from the GY, sets a monster's Level from 1 to 10.
Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness
Forces attacks into the center monster, and sends a monster to revive an Elfnote of another Attribute.
Elfnotes: Aristeia of Trust
Moves your monsters between zones, and negates a Spell/Trap with three Elfnotes out.
Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
Stops the center monster being banished, and turns a Spell/Trap into a Tuner token of any Level from 1 to 4.
extra: Level 10: in the center zone only center monsters can attack, and it returns to summon an Elfnote each from the hand, Deck and GY.
Level 7: summons a Level 6 or lower Elfnote and lowers every Level 4+ monster by 3.
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning
Level 10: Synchro Summoned, negates every opposing face-up card.
